minor_findings.actual: Candidate §1 LF49-54: the candidate's own p16 control shows only that the UNMULTIPLIED swapped caption fails (ratio ≈1.18<2). Stronger and supportable: the printed swapped product with the theorem's factor 2 also fails. Examples: independent-fusion-controls with A=[4,9], ratio ≈5.07>2; or G1 concentrated near a large time T, where N1(G1)→0. Optional wording strengthening only.
minor_findings.Root_disposition: Optional strengthening only. The candidate correctly refuted the unmultiplied printed swap. The separate supplied measurable-band A=[4,9] control already proves ratio>4, so it also refutes the same wrong assignment with factor2. Preserve both scopes; do not claim the theorem itself false.

minor_findings.actual: Further print typos not itemized in the ledger, none consequential to the reconstruction: p16 'In summary' display writes |s1−s2|^{−α0}γ(x−y) instead of γ^0_{1,2}γ_{1,2}; p19 displays γ^0(s+t)γ(x−y)G(s,x)G(t,x), repeating the (3.5) x typo; p17 uses μ(dξ) without the edge subscript; p18 has x_{j0 1}; p21 has 'k1∈I2' for k0 and 'Q'_1,Q'_2,Q'_3' for Q'_0,Q'_1,Q'_2.
minor_findings.Root_disposition: Preserve as source observations. The needed norm/offset/coefficient/union issues are independently declared in our proof. Extra typography that is not used does not create another external-book proof obligation or require manuscript bloat.

minor_findings.actual: Quantifier bookkeeping: the per-family Q may depend on G, mu_e, A_e, the finite caps, θ and the vertex widths, not only on n1, n2 and D. Any adopted citation should state Theorem 3.1 in the ∀(G,mu,A)∃(Q,ℓ) form with the y-norm, and should not quote p15's 'possibly depending on n1,n2 and D' as if a kernel-independent Q were proved.
minor_findings.Root_disposition: Carry into the explicit new statement: per-family existence may depend on every deterministic input, including spectral/Laplace domains, damping and widths. The finite maximum and every-product consumer envelopes avoid a uniform or measurable selector.
